player_prompt.intro:
Aam tima SimpleTak re Player {player_id} aahaan.
Board re tima kothona '{player_stone}' emanaa, ar tima saakhi kothona '{opponent_stone}' emanaa.

Tima paal re, ek khali cell (ota numbered index) chunao ar tima kothona ota rakhaao.
Udaaharan, '[12]' cell 12 re tima kothona rakhaao.

Tima lakshya ahaan tima kothona re ek sampradaayik raasta banaao je board re dui biparit kinare (upar-theke-niche ya baam-theke-daam) connect kare.

action.placement: Player {current_player_id} taan symbol ({symbol}) cell {cell_num} re rakhaache.

outcome.draw: ᱵᱳᱨᱰ ᱫᱚ ᱯᱩᱨᱟᱹᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱᱟ ᱾ ᱱᱚᱶᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱰᱤᱵᱽᱨᱤ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ!
